description:
Normalized representation of a test or execution failure.
Line numbers, timings, memory addresses, and non-deterministic IDs are stripped.

test.description: Normalized test name or suite name
test.title: Test

exception.description: Exception or error type name (e.g. AssertionError)
exception.title: Exception

message.description: Normalized error message with volatile values stripped
message.title: Message

frames.description: List of normalized relative file paths involved in the failure stack
frames.title: Frames

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint hash of the canonical failure representation
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

title: NormalizedFailure
